_comment: The vol 10 cast as hero slots for the Meshy pipeline. Each entry is one text-to-3D generation (Meshy) → GLB installed via godot/tools/hero_uploader/ into godot/assets/3d/characters/heroes/ under 'file' → instanced by build_strip_panel.py per staging job. 'meshy_prompt' is the text-to-3D brief; 'texture_prompt' the Meshy texturing pass. One model per age; expressions come from pose + camera + the comic's own ink, not from the mesh. NOTE (the authorial rule): there is no 'arthur' hero. Wood is the character; the author is never staged.

locales_needed._comment: Blender locale builds not yet written (godot/tools/blender/locales/build_<name>.py → godot/assets/3d/locales/<name>.glb). build_strip_panel.py falls back to a bare ground plane when the GLB is missing, so heroes can be staged before sets exist.
